//: Copy this file to mcp_config.json (same directory) and edit. Every key is optional; anything omitted keeps its built-in default. An environment variable of the same name always wins over this file — see config.py ENV_KEYS. Run the get_server_config tool to confirm what took effect.
//bedrock_model_id: Pin ONE model for mwaa_get_failed_runs root-cause analysis. Setting this disables the fallback chain below, so an unreachable id fails loudly instead of quietly using a different model. Env: BEDROCK_MODEL_ID
//bedrock_model_candidates: Tried in order until one responds. Used only when bedrock_model_id is null. 'us.' ids are cross-Region inference profiles, needed because most current models are not available for direct on-demand invocation. Env: BEDROCK_MODEL_CANDIDATES (comma-separated)
//bedrock_max_tokens: Response budget for the analysis. Env: BEDROCK_MAX_TOKENS
//bedrock_region: Region for Bedrock only. null = the same Region as your workflows. Set this if the model you want is not offered where your workflows run. Env: BEDROCK_REGION
//default_poll_seconds: How long a single mwaa_poll_run call waits before returning. Env: MWAA_MCP_DEFAULT_POLL_SECONDS
//max_poll_seconds: Hard cap for a single poll. Keep below the Lambda timeout in template.yaml (120s) so the function returns status instead of being killed. Env: MWAA_MCP_MAX_POLL_SECONDS
